t: The Laser Wrench is primarily used to connect multiple Blocks together.$(br2)$(l:laserio:laser_node)Nodes$(/l) and $(l:laserio:laser_connector)Connectors$(/l) can be connected by Shift-RightClicking to select a block, and then right clicking another block to form a connecion.$(br2)The max connection range is 8 blocks.
激光扳手主要用于连接不同节点和连接器。$(br2)可先 Shift 右击$(l:laserio:laser_node)节点$(/l)或$(l:laserio:laser_connector)连接器$(/l)将其设置为基点，再右击另一方块构建连接。$(br2)连接的最大距离为 8 格。
The currently selected block is highlighted green.
当前选中的方块高亮为绿色。
